# paste

Published version: `cli/paste@0.2.6`. See the release inventory;
[latest.json](../../tests/release/latest.json) records the uploaded coordinates.

Merge input lines for MoonX.

```sh
moonx cli/paste@0.2.6 [-s] [-d LIST] [-z] [FILE...]
```

## Supported scope

Combine corresponding records from files, separated by TAB by default. Use - for stdin.

## Options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-s` / `--serial` | none | Join each file's records into one output record. |
| `-d` / `--delimiters` | required | Cycle through delimiters. |
| `-z` / `--zero-terminated` | none | Use NUL-delimited records. |
| `--help` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `--version` | none | Show help / package version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Argument and exit-status contract

Ordinary option/operand errors exit 1; documented capability refusals retain their own status.

See the [finite diagnostic profile](../../docs/compatibility.md#extensions-and-diagnostics).

## Limitations

- Delimiter processing uses byte rules, not multibyte characters.

## Examples

```sh
moonx cli/paste@0.2.6 first.txt second.txt
moonx cli/paste@0.2.6 -s -d, input.txt
```
